source_goal_version.digest_input_policy: relative_path+sha256+state+role over generated files and witness statements

problem_context.expected_behavior: Splice linklist_node immediately after the supplied predecessor linklist, preserving the original suffix and supporting linklist as either a sentinel head or an ordinary data node.
problem_context.input_output_contract: Own linklist node_next, the complete suffix beginning at its old successor, and linklist_node node_next disjointly; afterward linklist points to linklist_node and linklist_node begins the original suffix.
spec_hint: This is a local splice, not an operation rooted at a distinguished sentinel. Prefer explicit predecessor field ownership plus xizi_sll(first,l), or an equivalent predicate-first contract; do not force xizi_sll_head on an arbitrary predecessor.
preferred_hidden_properties: The old suffix xizi_sll(first,l) is preserved exactly and becomes the suffix of the inserted node.
forbidden_patterns: Do not model an arbitrary predecessor as a sentinel head; do not mirror the two assignments as a new Rocq algorithm.

annotation_contract.ready_condition: agent_result.annotation.status == completed and ready_for_annotation_check_round == true only after canonical QCP, case_lib coqc, and annotation-checking pass; self_reworkable_failures must be empty
annotation_contract.blocked_condition: only phase skill hard blockers should use status == blocked; self_repair_budget_exhausted is work evidence, not an automatic blocked condition

required_lessons.must_address: Review previous annotation blocker before retry.

prior_failure_summaries.reason: Generated proof_manual freshness mismatch: canonical QCP reported one manual return witness but accepted generated proof_manual was empty because the file pre-existed during the revised annotation refresh. Regenerate all artifacts from a fresh manual target.

mathematical_postconditions_required: Function specs must state what result the function computes, not only bounds or shape facts.
Loop invariants must connect processed state to the final mathematical postcondition.
avoid_spec_antipatterns: Do not weaken the spec to shape-only or bounds-only conditions.
Do not restate the C loops as the mathematical definition.
